text:
Tess: Customer reported a promo redeemed in the mobile app — UI showed success and they got an email, but org balance still 0. grant_id=7a9f2, org=org_512ab, user=sam@acme.co, redeemed 2026-03-16T18:12Z

Leo: can you paste the grant_id + webhook id and any payloads? I'll check the grants + ledger rows.

Tess: grant_id 7a9f2, webhook wh_61cb returned 200. payload snippet: { "grant_id": "7a9f2", "org_id": "org_512ab", "amount_cents": 10000, "currency": "USD" }

Leo: quick DB check — grants row exists but applied=false; error_reason='account_currency_mismatch: org_currency=EUR grant_currency=USD'. Mobile flow might be sending USD while the org is in EUR.

Maya: OPS note — last account migration added an explicit account_currency column. apply_grant job now validates currency equality and rejects if mismatched. Some older grants (and some mobile flows) still send USD by default. ledger-bot shows a validation error.

ledger-bot: apply job log excerpt:
```
2026-03-16T18:13:02Z INFO apply_grant(grant_id=7a9f2)
2026-03-16T18:13:02Z ERROR reject: VALIDATION_ERROR: currency_mismatch (org=EUR grant=USD)
```

Tess: Customer says the in-app copy literally said "You got $100 in credits" and email echoed USD. They want the credits posted — it's blocking onboarding.

Leo: repro idea: mobile probably omits org currency header. Repro curl (simulates mobile):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_512ab","grant_code":"PROMO100","currency":"USD"}'
```
This will create a grant in USD, then the apply job will reject for EUR org.

Maya: immediate mitigation options:
- manual ledger entry with fx conversion (idempotent) to unblock customer
- re-run apply job with a temporary flag to allow currency auto-convert for single grant
- longer-term: enforce org_currency in mobile payload and backfill null/legacy grants

Leo: I'll do the manual apply now. Steps: 1) compute fx rate (morning rate 1.02 USD->EUR) 2) create ledger tx with note 'manual fx applied by Leo' 3) mark grant.applied=true and link tx_id. Will ensure idempotency checks.

ledger-bot: manual apply run:
```
apply_manual(grant_id=7a9f2, operator=leo)
-> convert 10000 cents USD @ 1.02 -> 9803 cents EUR
-> create ledger_tx tx_82910
-> update grant.applied=true grant.tx_id=tx_82910
```

Leo: done — tx_82910 posted at 2026-03-16T18:20Z, amount_eur=9803, note='manual fx applied by Leo'. I added a ledger note and idempotency token.

ledger-bot: transaction posted tx_82910 at 2026-03-16T18:20:47Z

Tess: Customer confirmed balance updated and sent thanks :tada:

Leo: Follow-ups (action items):
- PR: mobile client to include org_currency in redemption payload (will open today)
- Patch: apply_grant job to accept and soft-convert grants where safe, plus an alert on currency rejections
- Migration: backfill grants with null currency = org currency where appropriate

Maya: Logged INC-2026-443 for tracking, scheduled migration task, and added runbook entry.

Tess: Closing case — internal notes + runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/grants-currency-mismatch. Will ping for postmortem once PRs are up.
